name: Example analysis A — Shackleton rim crest
summary: Example analysis location on a local high of the Shackleton rim, about 6 km from the south pole. It is NOT an officially designated landing site.

name: Example analysis B — near-side ridge
summary: Example analysis location on a ridge near east longitude 58°, on the Earth-facing side of the south pole. It is NOT an officially designated landing site.

name: Example analysis C — Shackleton floor
summary: Example analysis location on the floor of Shackleton crater, surrounded by the rim. It is NOT an officially designated landing site.
